summary: The player understood the core 2048 orb-drop loop and reached a 64-orb, but experienced a slow 5.4s start and repeated mid-game uncertainty. The biggest friction was an almost-invisible countdown timer that caused an abrupt 'TIME'S UP!' fail screen at 51.0s.

items.title: Subtle timer leads to abrupt TIME'S UP! fail screen
items.evidence: The countdown timer is only a thin, unlabeled vertical line along the left wall of the container, so the 'TIME'S UP! Best orb: 64' overlay at 51.0s catches the player off guard (38% clarity on level_end).
items.suggestion: Replace or supplement the left-wall bar with a clear numeric countdown badge (e.g., '0:50') in the top HUD that pulses red in the final 10 seconds.

items.title: Slow 3.5s idle start and 5.4s to first merge
items.evidence: The session had 3.5s of no motion or input at the start and took 5.4s to achieve the first visible merge, despite the static 'Drag to aim, release to drop!' prompt and 'Match equal orbs to merge!' banner.
items.suggestion: Add an animated dragging hand indicator over the starting 2-orb and a pulsing highlight ring around the matching target orb at the bottom on frame 0.

items.title: Mid-game aiming uncertainty and prominent 0-count Bomb UI
items.evidence: Eleven unclear_screen signals (38%-48% clarity) fired during gameplay; the board lacks a landing-orb ghost preview, and the 'BOMB' button stays large and bright in the top-right even when its counter is '0'.
items.suggestion: Dim the 'BOMB' button when its count is 0, and add a subtle pulsing glow to any board orb that matches the currently held orb.
